title: The Ship Going the Other Way

youtube_full.title: The Ship Going the Other Way | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Jonah 1:1–6
youtube_full.description:
The Ship Going the Other Way: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Jonah 1:1–6.

Heavenly Father spoke to Jonah. He said, “Go to the big city of Nineveh.”

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Beau the Brave.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: The Ship Going the Other Way
1:10 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Beau the Brave
1:46 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
2:54 Question time
3:13 Sweet dreams
3:30 More stories, the app and the paperback
